cases.name: Christie M. McWilliams
cases.about: Her obituary said: "She was a graduate of Rittman High School and continued her education at the University of Mount Union, where she earned her Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) credential. Throughout her career, Christie worked in medical credentialing and as a real estate agent with Howard Hanna. Above all else, Christie found her greatest happiness in being a mother to Landon and McKinley. She was her children's biggest supporter and could always be found cheering enthusiastically from the sidelines at McKinley's sporting events. Her unwavering love, encouragement, and devotion to her family will be remembered always. Christie had a love for country music and enjoyed attending concerts whenever she could with friends and family. One of her most treasured recent memories was seeing Morgan Wallen perform live with her daughter, McKinley. She embraced life with an adventurous spirit, always seeking new experiences and finding joy even in life's simplest moments. Her warmth, enthusiasm, and appreciation for making memories touched those around her."
cases.narrative: He killed Christie, her daughter McKinley, a police sergeant and committed suicide during a standoff.

cases.name: McKinley McWilliam
cases.about: Her obituary said: "She attended Norwayne Middle School, where her bright personality and kind heart made a lasting impression on classmates and friends. McKinley was a vibrant, fun-loving young lady whose joyful spirit touched everyone she met. She shared a special bond with her mom through their mutual love of country music and treasured the memories they made together. An enthusiastic athlete, McKinley loved playing both softball and volleyball, where she not only developed her skills but also formed meaningful friendships with her teammates. Away from the field and the court, McKinley's creativity flourished through her artistic talent. She loved to draw and express herself through her artwork, and she enjoyed keeping up with the latest TikTok trends, often creating fun videos of her own. She also had a special place in her heart for her brother and confidant Landon and beloved cats, Brutus and Lucy."
